groupFailedMessage = stringResource(R.string.settings_group_failed)\n    val groupTakenMessage = stringResource(R.string.settings_group_name_taken)\n    val haptics = rememberMoriHaptics()\n     },\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    Surface(modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize()) {\n        when (uiState) {\n            SettingsUiState.Loading -> MoriLoading()\n\n            is SettingsUiState.Ready -> SettingsContent(\n                theme = uiState.theme,\n                reader = uiState.reader,\n                motion = uiState.motion,\n                storage = uiState.storage,\n                appLock = uiState.appLock,\n                groups = uiState.groups,\n                groupDialog = uiState.groupDialog,\n                sourceFolders = = appVersion,\n                snackbarHost = snackbarHost,\n            )\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/** Hub categories, each opening a detail screen. Order is the hub order. */\n@Serializable\nenum class SettingsCategory {\n    APPEARANCE,\n    READER,\n    SHELVES,\n    PRIVACY,\n    STORAGE,\n    ABOUT,\n}\n\n/** Type-safe nested destinations: hub list + one detail per category. */\n@Serializable\ninternal data object SettingsHub\n\n@Serializable\ninternal data class SettingsDetail(val category: SettingsCategory)\n\n@Composable\ninternal fun SettingsContent(\n    theme: ThemePreferences,\n    reader: ReaderPreferences,\n    motion: MotionStyle,\n    storage: StorageUsage?,\n    appLock: Boolean = false,\n    groups: List<UserCollection> = emptyList(),\n    groupDialog: GroupDialog? = null,\n    sourceFolders: List<SourceFolder> = emptyList(),\n    removeFolderUri: String? = null,\n    onAction: (SettingsAction) -> Unit,\n    onLicensesClick: () -> Unit = {},\n    appVersion: String = \"\",\n    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,\n    snackbarHost: SnackbarHostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() },\n) {\n    val haptics = rememberMoriHaptics()\n    val expressiveMotion = LocalExpressiveMotionEnabled.current\n    val rtl = LocalLayoutDirection.current != LayoutDirection.Ltr\n    // Nested backstack like the reference app: the system predictive-back\n    // gesture scrubs the pop transition natively, so no custom back preview,\n    // snap, or BackHandler lives here \u2014 the NavHost owns hub<->detail.\n    // Push mirrors Tomato: full-width slide-in over a 1/4 parallax fade-out;\n    // pop reverses it. Calm motion keeps the plain fade.\n    val settingsNav = rememberNavController()\n    NavHost(\n        navController = settingsNav,\n        startDestination = SettingsHub,\n        enterTransition = {\n            if (!expressiveMotion) {\n                fadeIn(animationSpec = MoriMotion.calmFade())\n            } else {\n                slideInHorizontally(animationSpec = MoriMotion.tabEnterSpec()) {\n                    if (rtl) -it else it\n                }\n            }\n        },\n        exitTransition = {\n            if (!expressiveMotion) {\n                fadeOut(animationSpec = MoriMotion.calmFade())\n            } else {\n                fadeOut(animationSpec = MoriMotion.tabExitSpec()) +\n                    slideOutHorizontally(animationSpec = MoriMotion.tabExitSpec()) {\n                        if (rtl) it / 4 else -it / 4\n                    }\n            }\n        },\n        popEnterTransition = {\n            if (!expressiveMotion) {\n                fadeIn(animationSpec = MoriMotion.calmFade())\n            } else {\n                fadeIn(animationSpec = MoriMotion.tabEnterSpec()) +\n                    slideInHorizontally(animationSpec = MoriMotion.tabEnterSpec()) {\n                        if (rtl) it / 4 else -it / 4\n                    }\n            }\n        },\n        popExitTransition = {\n            if (!expressiveMotion) {\n                fadeOut(animationSpec = MoriMotion.calmFade())\n            } else {\n                slideOutHorizontally(animationSpec = MoriMotion.tabExitSpec()) {\n                    if (rtl) -it else it\n                }\n            }\n        },\n        modifier = modifier,\n    ) {\n        composable<SettingsHub> {\n            SettingsScaffold(\n                title = stringResource(R.string.settings_title),\n                snackbarHost = snackbarHost,\n                contentTag = SettingsTestTags.Content,\n            ) {\n                SettingsCategory.entries.forEach { entry ->\n                    HubRow(\n                        category = entry,\n                        onClick = {\n                            haptics(MoriHaptic.Select)\n                            settingsNav.navigate(SettingsDetail(entry))\n                        },\n                    )\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        composable<SettingsDetail> { detailEntry ->\n            // Type-safe: an unknown category can no longer arrive here and\n            // blank the screen; the route carries the enum itself.\n            val selected = detailEntry.toRoute<SettingsDetail>().category\n            SettingsScaffold(\n                title = categoryTitle(selected),\n                navigationBack = { settingsNav.popBackStack() },\n                snackbarHost = snackbarHost,\n                contentTag = SettingsTestTags.categoryFor(selected),\n            ) {\n                when (selected) {\n                    SettingsCategory.APPEARANCE -> AppearanceSection(\n                        theme = theme,\n                        motion = motion,\n                        onAction = onAction,\n                    )\n                    SettingsCategory.READER -> ReaderSection(\n                        reader = reader,\n                        onAction = onAction,\n                    )\n                    SettingsCategory.SHELVES -> ShelvesSection(\n                        groups = groups,\n                        groupDialog = groupDialog,\n                        onAction = onAction,\n                    )\n                    SettingsCategory.PRIVACY -> PrivacySection(\n                        appLock = appLock,\n                        incognito = reader.incognito,\n                        onAction = onAction,\n                    )\n                    SettingsCategory.STORAGE -> StorageSection(\n                        storage = storage,\n                        sourceFolders = sourceFolders,\n                        removeFolderUri = removeFolderUri,\n                        onAction = onAction,\n                    )\n                    SettingsCategory.ABOUT -> AboutSection(\n                        appVersion = appVersion,\n                        onLicensesClick = onLicensesClick,\n                    )\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Shared scaffold for the hub and every detail screen: collapsing title,\n * optional back navigation, snackbar, and bottom reserve for the floating\n * navigator.\n *\n * Uses enter-always: the header hides on swipe up but returns on any swipe\n * down. exitUntilCollapsed sticks fully off-screen with this M3 Expressive\n * bar and never comes back.\n */\n@OptIn(androidx.compose.material3.ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)\n@Composable\nprivate fun SettingsScaffold(\n    title: String,\n    snackbarHost: SnackbarHostState,\n    contentTag: String,\n    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,\n    navigationBack: (() -> Unit)? = null,\n    content: @Composable () -> Unit,\n) {\n    // Enter-always: the header hides on swipe up but returns on any swipe\n    // down. exitUntilCollapsed scrolled fully off this bar and stuck there.\n    val scrollBehavior = TopAppBarDefaults.enterAlwaysScrollBehavior()\n    val contentScroll = rememberScrollState()\n    Scaffold(\n        topBar = {\n            MoriCollapsingTopBar(\n                title = title,\n                scrollBehavior = scrollBehavior,\n                navigationIcon = {\n                    if (navigationBack != null) {\n                        IconButton(onClick = navigationBack) {\n                            Icon(\n                                imageVector = MoriIcons.Back,\n                                contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.settings_navigate_back),\n                            )\n                        }\n                    }\n                },\n            )\n        },\n        // Always attached: gating on canScroll created a one-way trap \u2014 once\n        // the connection detached, nothing could ever re-expand the bar.\n        modifier = modifier.nestedScroll(scrollBehavior.nestedScrollConnection),\n        snackbarHost = {\n            SnackbarHost(\n                hostState = snackbarHost,\n                modifier = Modifier.testTag(SettingsTestTags.Snackbar),\n            )\n        },\n    ) { padding ->\n        Surface(\n            modifier = Modifier\n                .fillMaxSize()\n content()\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/** One hub row: icon, title, subtitle, chevron. 72dp expressive target. */\\n@Composable\\nprivate fun HubRow(\\n    category: LocalAppFonts.current.displaySoft,\\n            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,\\n        ),\\n        modifier = modifier.testTag(SettingsTestTags.categoryFor(category)),\\n        trailing = {\\n {"result": "package com.mori.core.common\n\n/**\n * Human-readable byte counts for storage UI (B/KB/MB/GB, one decimal,\n * whole numbers without a trailing fraction).\n */\nfun formatBytes(bytes: Long): String {\n    if (bytes < 1024) return \"$bytes B\"\n    val units = listOf(\"KB\", \"MB\", \"GB\")\n    var value = bytes.toDouble() / 1024\n    var unit = units[0]\n    for (next in units.drop(1)) {\n        if (value < 1024) break\n        value /= 1024\n        unit = next\n    }\n    val rounded = (value * 10).toLong() / 10.0\n    return if (rounded == rounded.toLong().toDouble()) {\n        \"${rounded.toLong()} $unit\"\n    } else {\n        \"$rounded $unit\"\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Percent readout for -1..1 / 0..1 filter sliders, e.g. \"-40%\", \"75%\".\n */\nfun formatPercent(value: Float): String {\n    val percent = (value * 100).toInt()\n    return \"$percent%\"\n}\n\n/**\n * Compact duration: 45s, 12m, 3h 20m.\n */\nfun formatDuration(totalMs: Long): String {\n    val totalSeconds = totalMs.coerceAtLeast(0L) / 1000L\n    val hours = totalSeconds / 3600L\n    val minutes = (totalSeconds % 3600L) / 60L\n    val seconds = totalSeconds % 60L\n    return when {\n        hours > 0L -> \"${hours}h ${minutes}m\"\n        minutes > 0L -> \"${minutes}m\"\n        else -> \"${seconds}s\"\n    }\n}\n"}

# Plan: Bolder Stats (Reading Time & Streak) and Unified Header Hierarchy

## Problem Analysis

### 1. Stats Section: Reading Time and Streak Text
- **Soft / Pill-shaped Numeral Face**: In [`StatsScreen.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/stats/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/stats/impl/StatsScreen.kt#L365-L380), [`HeroNumber`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/stats/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/stats/impl/StatsScreen.kt#L365) uses `LocalAppFonts.current.displaySoft`. In [`AppFonts.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/AppFonts.kt#L70), `displaySoft` sets `FontVariation.Setting("ROND", 100f)`. While playful for icons/avatars, this extreme roundness softens straight stems on uppercase letters (e.g. `"3H 20M"`, `"4 DAYS"`), diluting visual punch and crisp edge definition.
- **Thin Numeral Labels**: The captions below the hero numerals ("Time reading", "Pages turned", "Longest: 4 days") use [`MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/stats/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/stats/impl/StatsScreen.kt#L381), which in [`MoriTypography`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/Type.kt#L60) resolves to `BodyFlex` (weight 400, regular). They appear faint and light under the large numerals.
- **Thin Section Card Headers**: The "Streak" and "Reading time" cards in Stats are wrapped in [`MoriSectionCard(title = ...)`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriSectionCard.kt). [`MoriSectionCard`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriSectionCard.kt#L28) renders its title with `MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge`. In [`Type.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/Type.kt#L66), `titleLarge` is mapped to `baseline.titleLarge.body()` (weight 400, regular). Consequently, the "Reading time" and "Streak" headers themselves are thin and lack structural prominence.

### 2. Disjointed Header Hierarchy Across Features
Headers currently use inconsistent text styles and weights across modules:
- **Level 1 (Screen Top Bars)**:
  - `Library`, `Stats`, `Settings`, `Licenses`: [`MoriCollapsingTopBar`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriTopBar.kt) uses `ScreenTitleSize` (28sp) with `LocalAppFonts.current.topBarTitle` (Black 900).
  - `DetailScreen`: Uses `headlineSmall` (24sp) with `topBarTitle`.
  - `OnboardingScreen`: Uses `MoriEmphasized.headlineMedium` (28sp) with `displaySoft` + `FontWeight.Black`.
- **Level 2 (Section / Group Headers)**:
  - `MoriSectionCard`: Uses `titleLarge` (weight 400 regular).
  - `ShelfSectionHeader` ([`LibraryScreen.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/library/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/library/impl/LibraryScreen.kt#L685)): Uses `titleLarge` (weight 400 regular).
  - `SectionHeading` ([`StatsScreen.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/stats/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/stats/impl/StatsScreen.kt#L430)): Uses `MoriEmphasized.titleSmall` (14sp, bold).
- **Level 3 (Modal / Sheet Sub-Headers)**:
  - `LibrarySortFilterSheet`: Uses `titleMedium` (16sp, SemiBold).
  - `ReaderSettingsSheet`: Uses `titleMedium` for sheet title, `MoriEmphasized.titleSmall` for groups.

---

## Proposed Unified Hierarchy (Material 3 Expressive)

| Tier | Semantic Role | Font Family / Weight | Size / Line Height | Components & Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Level 1** | **Screen Title (App Bar)** | `LocalAppFonts.current.topBarTitle` (Black 900, 112.5% width) | `ScreenTitleSize` (28sp) / `ScreenTitleLineHeight` (28sp) | [`MoriCollapsingTopBar`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriTopBar.kt) across all primary tabs & destination screens |
| **Level 1b** | **Screen Hero / Step Title** | `HeadingFlex` (SemiBold / Bold) or `topBarTitle` | 28sp / 36sp (`headlineMedium`) | `OnboardingScreen` wizard steps, [`MoriEmptyState`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriStates.kt) |
| **Level 2** | **Major Section Header** | `HeadingFlex` (Bold 700) via [`MoriEmphasized.titleLarge`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/EmphasizedType.kt) | 22sp / 28sp (`titleLarge`) | [`MoriSectionCard`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriSectionCard.kt) titles, `ShelfSectionHeader` in Library, `SectionHeading` in Stats |
| **Level 3** | **Sheet / Group Sub-Header** | `HeadingFlex` (Bold 700) via [`MoriEmphasized.titleMedium`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/EmphasizedType.kt) | 16sp / 24sp (`titleMedium`) | Filter/sort sheet groups, reader settings sections, option sheet titles |
| **Level 4** | **Item / Row Title** | `HeadingFlex` (SemiBold 600) via `MoriTypography.bodyLarge` | 16sp / 24sp | [`MoriSettingRow`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriSettingRow.kt), book card labels, list items |
| **Hero Data** | **Stats Metric Numeral** | `LocalAppFonts.current.displayFlex` (Black 900, 125% width, sharp) | 28sp - 64sp (`HeroMaxSize`) | Reading duration, streak count, pages turned in [`HeroNumber`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/stats/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/stats/impl/StatsScreen.kt) |
| **Hero Label** | **Stats Metric Label** | `HeadingFlex` (SemiBold 600) via `MoriEmphasized.labelLarge` | 14sp / 20sp | "Time reading", "Pages turned", "Longest: 4 days", "Sessions" |

## Detailed Implementation Steps

### Step 1: Design System Foundations (`core:designsystem`)
1. **[`Type.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/Type.kt)**:
   - Update `titleLarge = baseline.titleLarge.heading()` so base `titleLarge` carries `HeadingFlex` (600 SemiBold) instead of thin `BodyFlex` (400).

Haptics and\n * selected-label emphasis match the connected group.\n */\n@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3ExpressiveApi::class, ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)\n@Composable\nfun MoriFilterPills(\n    options: List<MoriChoiceOption>,\n    selectedIndex: Int,\n    onSelect: (Int) -> Unit,\n    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,\n    testTagFor: (Int) -> String = { \"filter:$it\" },\n) {\n    val haptics = rememberMoriHaptics()\n    FlowRow(\n        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),\n        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),\n        modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(),\n    ) {\n        options.forEachIndexed { index, option ->\n            val selected = index == selectedIndex\n            ToggleButton(\n                checked = selected,\n                onCheckedChange = {\n                    haptics(MoriHaptic.Select)\n                    onSelect(index)\n                },\n                shapes = ToggleButtonDefaults.shapes(CircleShape, CircleShape, CircleShape),\n                modifier = Modifier\n                    .heightIn(min = 48.dp)\n                    .testTag(testTagFor(index))\n                    .semantics { this.selected = selected },\n            ) {\n                Text(\n                    text = option.label,\n                    style = if (selected) {\n                        MoriEmphasized.labelLarge\n                    } else {\n                        MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge\n                    },\n                    maxLines = 1,\n                )\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}

### Assistant (Step 947)

### Summary of Completed Work

#### 1. Reader UI Responsiveness & Mihon-Reimagined M3 Expressive Overhaul
- **Floating Expressive Pill Bar**: Replaced static full-width bottom scrim bars with a unified floating M3 Expressive pill surface (`RoundedCornerShape(32.dp)`, `surfaceContainerHigh`, tonal/shadow elevation, outline border) hosting:
  - **Scrubber Row**: Direction-aware steppers with continuous slider and layout-stable page numbers.
  - **Live Floating Page Tooltip**: Animated floating bubble above the slider showing `Page X / Y` with scale/fade transitions while scrubbing.
  - **Quick Action Bar (Mihon Reimagined)**: Quick-access controls for Reading Direction, Page Fit, Margin Crop, Thumbnail Overview, and Reader Settings.
- **Pulsar Haptics Integration**:
  - `MoriHaptic.FrequentTick` fired during continuous page scrubbing ticks.
  - `MoriHaptic.Select` fired on stepper clicks, slider release, and quick actions.
- **Responsive Auto-Hide Chrome**: Extended auto-hide chrome timer to 5000ms and bumped on every chrome touch to avoid abrupt dismissals while interacting with reader controls.
- **Floating Scrim Page Indicator**: Enhanced [`MoriScrimPill.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/core/designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/core/designsystem/MoriScrimPill.kt) to accept custom text styling (`MoriEmphasized.labelLarge`).

#### 2. Stats Section Typography & Hierarchy Unification
- **Hero Stats**: Updated reading time and streak numbers in [`StatsScreen.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/stats/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/stats/impl/StatsScreen.kt) to use `LocalAppFonts.current.displayFlex` with `FontWeight.Black` and `FontStyle.Italic` for high-impact emphasis.
- **Unified Section Headings**: Standardized section headings to `MoriEmphasized.titleLarge` with `semantics { heading() }`.

#### 3. Library Sheet Fix & Test Suite Verification
- Resolved the compilation and syntax issues in [`LibrarySortFilterSheet.kt`](file:///Users/priyanshu/git/mori/feature/library/impl/src/main/kotlin/com/mori/feature/library/impl/LibrarySortFilterSheet.kt) with proper mapping for `LibraryFilter` and `LibrarySortOrder`.

_Thinking:_



All eight locked. Here is the final execution plan — ready to run when you flip back to build mode:

## Plan: shelf repair + multi-folder manager

### A. Shelf repair (correctness first)
1. **Crash on re-add** — `CollectionDao.addMember` gets `@Insert(onConflict = IGNORE)` + repo pre-check; `DetailViewModel.toggleShelfMember` serialized under the existing refresh mutex with caught errors → snackbar message.
2. **Orphan members** — `removeComic` prunes `collection_members` in the same `@Transaction`; member-count query joins against existing comics so counts can't inflate.
3. **Shelf delete** — explicit `deleteMembersByCollection` alongside CASCADE; `deleteGroup` also prunes the id from persisted `collapsedShelfIds` and clears a selected ghost from `SavedStateHandle`.
4. **Loud validation** — duplicate/overlong names rejected with message + counter; text fields get `maxLength`; failed create keeps the dialog open with typed text intact (fixes the name-wipe bug + stale rename text via keyed `remember`).
5. **Loud failures everywhere** — Settings + Detail shelf ops surface snackbar errors instead of closing-and-snapping-back.
6. **Fake alignment** — test fake prunes on delete and enforces truncation, so tests can't mask prod behavior again.

### B. Multi-folder manager (Storage section, expressive components)
- **Data**: `sourceTreeUris: Set<String>` prefs key with one-time migration from the legacy single key; `addSourceTreeUri`/`removeSourceTreeUri`; repository gains `indexLinkedTrees(uris)` (union list, single upsert, prune against the union — fixes the would-wipe-other-sources bug) and `removeSourceTree(uri)` (prefix-matched row + cover purge).
- **Rescan**: `reindex()` loops all trees with aggregated progress/failed counts; adding a folder auto-triggers a rescan; one rescan-all button; launch-rescan gates on empty set.
- **UI** (all expressive): folder list as `MoriSettingRow`s (folder icon, display name via `DocumentFile`, book count, trailing remove) inside Storage under the usage hero; full-width expressive filled **Add folder** button launching the same `OpenDocumentTree` + persistable-permission flow as onboarding; destructive confirm dialog on remove (files stay, books leave); revoked/missing folders render as amber error rows with **Relink** + **Remove**, books held until you decide.
- **State**: `SettingsUiState` gains `sourceFolders: List<SourceFolder(id, displayName, bookCount, reachable)>`; new `SettingsAction.AddSource/RemoveSource/ConfirmRemoveSource/RelinkSource`; picker result flows through the existing folder-pick plumbing.

### Verification per batch
Unit tests (union rescan, per-source prune, migration, validation, loud-failure paths) → full gate → device screenshots (Storage manager, error rows, shelf dialogs) → push + CI.

  "newString": "    init {\n        // Rescan on every launch: the library reads user folders in place,\n        // so a launch pass picks up files added, moved or removed outside\n        // the app. With no tree linked there is nothing to rescan; manual\n        // rescans stay on pull-to-refresh (plus the empty-state button).\n        viewModelScope.launch {\n            if (preferences.sourceTreeUri.first() == null) return@launch\n            reindex()\n        }\n        // Prune shelf references deleted elsewhere (Settings): a selected\n        // shelf that no longer exists is cleared instead of lingering as a\n        // ghost filter id, and collapsed ids of gone shelves stop\n        // accumulating in persisted prefs.\n        viewModelScope.launch {\n            repository.observeCollections().distinctUntilChanged().collect { collections ->\n                val ids = collections.map { it.id }.toSet()\n                val selected = selectedCollection.value\n                if (selected != null && selected !in ids) {\n                    selectedCollection.value = null\n                    savedStateHandle.remove<Long>(KEY_COLLECTION)\n                }\n                val collapsed = preferences.libraryQuery.first().collapsedShelfIds\n                val pruned = collapsed.intersect(ids)\n                if (pruned != collapsed) {\n                    updateQuery { it.copy(collapsedShelfIds = pruned) }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }",
  "oldString": "    init {\n        // Rescan on every launch: the library reads user folders in place,\n        // so a launch pass picks up files added, moved or removed outside\n        // the app. With no tree linked there is nothing to rescan; manual\n        // rescans stay on pull-to-refresh (plus the empty-state button).\n        viewModelScope.launch {\n            if (preferences.sourceTreeUri.first() == null) return@launch\n            reindex()\n        }\n    }"
}
